prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A striking, high-fashion editorial scene set in a stark, minimalist white room with seamless walls and floor, creating a sense of infinite space. The subject is a poised, androgynous model with slicked-back dark hair, exuding confidence and attitude. They wear a long, tailored black overcoat that contrasts sharply against the pristine white background, paired with glossy, thigh-high black patent leather boots. The model stands in a dynamic pose, one leg extended horizontally to press the sole of their boot against the adjacent wall, emphasizing both the length of the boots and the geometric lines of the space. Their expression is cool and self-assured, with a subtle, enigmatic gaze directed toward the camera. The lighting is bright and even, eliminating shadows and enhancing the graphic quality of the composition. The overall style is bold, avant-garde, and cinematic, reminiscent of high-contrast black-and-white fashion photography. The camera angle is slightly low and frontal, capturing the full figure and the dramatic interaction between the model and the architectural environment, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus crisp on the subject while the background remains clean and unobtrusive.
